subject: Re: Upgrade request — monthly allocation & rate-tier migration
messages:
From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Howard <ben.howard@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Increase to monthly allocation + rate limits question

Hey Connor,

Quick note from our side — our product team is seeing sustained growth and we need to increase our hosted API allocation. Current commit is 10M tokens/month; we want to move to 25M tokens/month starting Apr 1 (ideally).

Two specific asks:
- Can you confirm the pricing tiers for 25M vs. 10M and how rate limits map (rps / burst)?
- If we upgrade mid-term, what is the billing/proration behavior? Any impact to our current credits?

We also have occasional bursts during campaigns (short spikes up to ~1200 QPS for 3–6 minutes). Will the higher tier help or do we need a separate burst add-on?

Attaching our monthly usage export for context.

Thanks,
Amanda
Amanda Lee
Head of Platform
Acme Analytics

Attachment: Acme_usage_summary.csv (csv)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Howard <ben.howard@acme-analytics.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-09T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Increase to monthly allocation + rate limits question

Amanda — thanks for the context and the usage export. High level answers below; I can set up a short call with product/infra if you'd like a deeper dive.

Summary:
- Pricing: 25M/month moves you into the "Tier C" discounted band. I'll send an exact pricing worksheet for your account, but ballpark is ~22% unit discount vs. your current plan.
- Rate limits: Default rate limit for Tier C is 600 QPS sustained with a 1.5x short-term burst window. That won't cover your 1200 QPS spikes on its own. Two options:
  1) Tier C + Burst Add-on (30-day rolling burst pool) — recommended for campaign spikes.
  2) Keep Tier C and provision a temporary Dedicated burst reservation for scheduled campaigns.
- Proration: Upgrades are prorated daily. Any unused credits will apply to the upgraded invoice first.

I attached a proposed pricing & commit worksheet and a recommended rate profile for Acme. If this looks ok I can loop in Sales Ops (Lauren) to prepare the amendment + DocuSign.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm target effective date (you suggested Apr 1).
2) Pick burst approach (add-on vs. temporary dedicated reservation).
3) Sign amendment (DocuSign) — Lauren will handle procurement flow.

If helpful, I can block 30 minutes tomorrow for a quick sync with your infra lead to validate burst behavior.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0132

Attachment: Proposed_Commits_Pricing_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Howard <ben.howard@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-03-11T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Increase to monthly allocation + rate limits question

Thanks Connor — that helps. Apr 1 is our preferred go-live. A few clarifications:
- We do have a limited pool of partner credits expiring in April; please confirm they can be consumed on the new invoice.
- For the burst option, our infra team prefers the Dedicated reservation model if we can schedule known campaign windows; less operational complexity for us.

Can you confirm the committed spend number that will appear on the amendment so procurement can start a PO?

Also looping Ben here — Ben, can you share the calendar for campaign spikes next quarter so we can propose dates for any dedicated reservations?

Best,
Amanda

Hi Amanda / Connor,

Thanks — looping in Sales Ops for the amendment. A few operational notes for procurement:
- Amendment will reflect a new committed allocation of 25,000,000 tokens/month (Tier C).
- Committed monthly spend (pre-discount) will show as $37,500; with the agreed unit discount it will bill as $29,250/month. The DocuSign will contain the exact line items.
- Credits: per our billing policy, existing Redwood credits are applied to outstanding invoices first and will be consumed against the upgraded bill automatically; we will call out the credit application on the first upgraded invoice.
- Burst plan: Connor indicated two options. Since Acme prefers scheduled dedicated reservations, we'll include a clause for temporary Dedicated reservations (terms and 14-day notice).

I've prepared a DocuSign draft and added tractable change notes. Please review and confirm: effective date = 2026-04-01, term = 12 months, auto-renew = yes (with 60-day opt-out).

Links: DocuSign draft (https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC123-upgrade)

If everything's green, I'll route to procurement and attach PO instructions.

—Lauren Bishop
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

- One-time concession: I'm requesting approval for a one-time 12% implementation credit to help offset migration work — Marissa, can you confirm?

Next steps for Amanda: Please review the DocuSign link Lauren shared and confirm the PO number when ready. Once signed, we’ll activate the new tier on Apr 1 and schedule a short infra handoff to reserve the dedicated burst windows.

Thanks all — looking forward to continued partnership.
